known_secrets.text: I have tracked forest boundary shifts over multiple seasons and confirmed slow inward and outward movement.
Some logging paths vanish not due to erosion, but due to tree regrowth patterns that do not match known cycles.
A few lost paths align with old terrace directions toward the monument.
I have not shared this fully with Tarek.
There are zones where trees grow in near-perfect alignment.
These zones feel unnatural to experienced loggers.
Fen has likely seen more of these zones than he admits.
Certain forest animals avoid these aligned zones entirely.

unknowns: True cause of Night of Ash
